formulario.ayudaIdioma: Only people with that language see it: the poll pool is kept separate.
formulario.ayudaOpciones: No option is a judgement: «I'm finding it hard» yes, «I'm a mess» no. Whoever answers is choosing how to describe themselves.
formulario.ayudaPregunta: It asks for neither a diagnosis nor a clinical detail, and it allows an honest answer that is neither the worst nor the best.
formulario.ayudaUmbral: Below this number of votes no percentage is published. It isn't cosmetic: with three votes and a small group, a percentage identifies whoever voted.
formulario.okGuardada1: The poll has been saved but
formulario.okGuardada2: it has not been published in the feed
formulario.okGuardada3: . What you wrote carries crisis signals, and a poll is served to the whole network. It still exists and is waiting for review: nothing has been deleted.
formulario.okPublicada: Poll published. It can now appear in the feed.

encuestas.intro1: A poll is served to the whole network from the feed. It is published with the moderation role and every creation is left in the audit log with who and when, not with what was written.
encuestas.intro2: If the question or any of the options carry crisis signals, the poll is saved but does NOT enter the feed, the event is recorded and the help resources are shown in the same response. Nothing is deleted or hidden silently.

panel.activacionDescripcion: People who signed up in the window and how far they got. The step to watch is the fourth: whoever doesn't get a validated comment will never be able to post, and leaves.
panel.crisisIncidente: Any value other than 100 % is an incident, not a metric.
panel.crisisOk: Every high or critical risk case in the window has been reviewed by a person.
panel.reciprocidadDescripcion: Validated listens per post over {dias} days. Each post consumes {umbral}: below that number the community only publishes at the expense of the free first posts of whoever has just arrived.
panel.reciprocidadSparkline: Reciprocity ratio over the last {dias} days. Threshold {umbral}.
panel.ttprDescripcion: Median time it takes someone to get a first response. Target: p50 under 15 min and p90 under 2 h.
panel.ttprP50Riesgo: p50 on high or critical risk posts
panel.ttprSinRespuesta24h: No response at all within 24 h
panel.ttprSparkline: Daily median of the time to first response, last {dias} days.

reciprocidad.explicacion: Validated listens per post. The threshold is {umbral} because each post consumes {umbral} listens: it isn't a vanity number, it's the arithmetic of the product.

One thing to know first: that email is stored in readable form in the sign-in system, tied to your account. Nobody in the community sees it and it never appears on any screen, but whoever administers the infrastructure can. If what you want is anonymity from everyone, do not link it: you can still get in.

teEscuchan.texto: Whoever replies has already been through what you just did. That's why they reply the way they do.

landing.bucleIntro: On almost every social network, speaking is free and listening is optional. Here it's the other way round. It's the only rule you need to understand.
landing.bucleTitulo: The loop: listening is what earns you the floor
landing.cierreTexto: We don't ask for your name, your face or your voice. You pick a pseudonym and you're in.
landing.intro: Darma is an anonymous social network for emotional growth, built on reciprocity. No photo, no real name, no voice. Just people who decided to listen before they speak.
landing.metaDescripcion: An anonymous social network for emotional growth, built on reciprocity. Listen to three people and your voice unlocks.
landing.metaTitulo: Darma · An anonymous social network for emotional growth

animo.detalle: You read someone and let them know they're not alone. Nothing to write, nothing to expose. It's the way in, and it asks for nothing back.

apoyo.detalle: You stay with someone through something, not just one message. Circles, follow-up, steady presence. It opens up for people who have shown they listen.

escucha.detalle: You write to someone who has just let it all out. Not quick advice: listening. Every validated listen earns a credit, and three credits open your turn to speak.

landing.nivelesIntro: You don't have to share anything to take part. You move up by doing, not by paying.
landing.nivelesTitulo: Three levels, and you start with the easiest
landing.pie: Darma is peer support, not healthcare. If you're in danger, get professional help right away.
landing.primeraGratis: Your first post is free. After that, the cycle keeps itself going.
landing.tituloLinea1: Nobody here knows who you are.

onboarding.paso3Texto: Not your name, not your email, not your city. Just this.

push.explicacion: We'd tell you when someone sits with you, when your message helps someone, and if a Kindred Soul needs to talk. Never to pull you back, never with streaks, and never with what anyone wrote: the alert doesn't show the text, because a locked screen can be read by anyone. At night everything waits until morning, unless a Kindred Soul is in crisis.

ayuda.entrada: These lines are answered by people trained to listen. They are confidential, and each card tells you whether the call is free. You don't need to be able to explain what is happening to you in order to call.

ayuda.noTerapiaCuerpo: The people who listen to you here have been through similar things, and that counts for a lot. But we are not mental health professionals and we cannot handle an emergency. If you are at risk, call one of the numbers above: there is someone trained to help you on the other end, right now.
ayuda.noTerapiaTitulo: Darma is not a replacement for therapy
ayuda.sinVerificar: We are still confirming these numbers one by one with each organisation. If one of them doesn't answer, try the next one on the list, or the emergency number for the country you're in.

economia.cupoGratis: You get one free boost a day. It's paid for by the karma you already earned listening to other people: being read never depends on paying.
economia.explicacionCristales: Crystals pay for decoration and a little reach, for a while. They don't raise your karma, they don't put you ahead of anyone in a queue, and they don't change the order in which someone in crisis is attended to.
economia.explicacionRegalo: A gift is a visible gesture in the thread. Part of it stays with Darma to keep it going and the rest reaches the person, in crystals. It gives them no karma: karma is earned by listening.

respaldo.hecho: Done. The backup is saved and only your phrase opens it.
respaldo.hechoExplicacion: If you ever change phones, type those twelve words and your conversations come back. If you lose them, they don't.
respaldo.sinRecuperacion: There is no recovery by email, by support, or by checking who you are. Any of those would mean Darma held your key, and then we could read what you write. We don't have it and we don't want it.

refugios.vacio: You're not in any shelter yet.
